text_block_list.name: Dearing Tact
text_block_list.text:
Mmm...
Nothing at all...

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear, nothing on your end either?
That is quite troublesome.

text_block_list.name: Dearing Tact
text_block_list.text:
Heart-san... Yes.
Not just the fishing, but my school assignment isn't making much progress either.

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text:
Ah, you mean discovering your own unique 'strength'?
That really is quite a hard assignment.

text_block_list.name: Dearing Tact
text_block_list.text:
Yes... But without rushing,
I want to face it head-on.

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text:
That sounds wonderful.
...Well then, let's give up on fishing and head back.
We need to find something else for dinner.

text_block_list.name: Dearing Tact
text_block_list.text:
Shall we forage for some mushrooms instead?
I spotted some on our way here!

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text:
Oh no!
They've almost all been nibbled on!

text_block_list.name: Dearing Tact
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... Guess we're out of luck.
Judging by the bite marks, maybe squirrels?
...Shall we check other spots?

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text: Seriously? Now these are full of bug bites!

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text:
*sigh*... No fish and now this, how unfortunate.
And our packed rations are already running low.

text_block_list.name: Dearing Tact
text_block_list.text:
This is tough...
Everything growing around here has been eaten into as well.

text_block_list.name: Dearing Tact
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... It seems everyone gets
hungry just the same.
Or perhaps these were just exceptionally delicious?

text_block_list.name: Dearing Tact
text_block_list.text:
At any rate, let's call it a day here
and make do with our remaining dried meat and wild herbs.

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text:
...
—Fufu!

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text:
Ah, pardon me.
...You really don't get flustered at all, do you?

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text:
I mean, aren't we in quite a pinch right now?
At this hour,
we haven't managed to secure a proper meal.

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text:
And yet you... Fufu!
As always, you have admirable nerves of steel!

text_block_list.name: Dearing Tact
text_block_list.text:
A pinch...
I suppose that's true.

text_block_list.name: Dearing Tact
text_block_list.text:
But doing everything to survive
is something the animals are doing as well.

text_block_list.name: Dearing Tact
text_block_list.text: Everyone is desperately living through whatever situation they find themselves in at any given moment.

text_block_list.name: Dearing Tact
text_block_list.text:
If we couldn't secure food,
then we simply adapt and live with what we have.

text_block_list.name: Dearing Tact
text_block_list.text:
Everyone is equal in nature,
so we must accept it too!

text_block_list.name: Dearing Tact
text_block_list.text:
...So tonight's dinner will be soup with scraps of dried meat and plenty of wild herbs!
It's settled!

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. Hahaha!
It's as if you are nature itself.

text_block_list.name: Dearing Tact
text_block_list.text: Eh?

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text:
Grand, generous, and vast.
That kind of spirit isn't something just anyone can possess.

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text:
It's something special.
—Cherish it well.

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text:
Right! Let's pick some wild herbs and head back!
I saw some nice ones over that way earlier...

On a day off.
Just as I was about to head out shopping...

text_block_list.name: Dearing Tact
text_block_list.text:
—Heart-san,
thank you so much for everything this time...!

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text:
It was nothing.
...Did you find your own answer?

text_block_list.name: Dearing Tact
text_block_list.text:
Yes! ...As soon as I get back to the dorm,
I'll get right to work on the report!
